# Waysorted

> Accelerate every idea with one powerful suite

Waysorted is a unified creative workflow suite built by **Waysorted Infotech Pvt Ltd**. It replaces multiple Figma plugins with one powerful platform for designers.

## Quick Facts

- **Company**: Waysorted Infotech Pvt Ltd
- **Website**: https://www.waysorted.com
- **Platform**: Figma Plugin
- **Category**: Design Tools, Productivity
- **Pricing**: Free to start

## Products

### PDF Exporter
Export Figma frames to high-quality PDF with zero latency. No server uploads - client-side processing keeps your data secure.
- [Learn More](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/pdf-exporter)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/pdf-exporter)

### Palettable
Generate beautiful color palettes with instant contrast checking for accessible designs. WCAG compliance built-in.
- [Learn More](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/palettable)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/palettable)

### Unit Converter
Real-time conversion between px, rem, em, and pt. No more manual calculations.
- [Learn More](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/unit-converter)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/unit-converter)

### Import Tool
Fast asset import into Figma. Supports images, SVGs, and more with drag-and-drop.
- [Learn More](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/import-tool)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/import-tool)

## Key Features

- **Zero Latency**: Client-side processing, no server delays
- **Local-First Architecture**: Your data stays on your device
- **GDPR Compliant**: Privacy-first design
- **Encrypted Workflows**: Secure data handling
- **All-in-One**: Replace multiple plugins with one suite

## FAQ

**What is Waysorted?**
Waysorted is a unified Figma plugin suite that combines PDF export, color palettes, unit conversion, and asset import into one tool.

**Is Waysorted free?**
Yes, Waysorted is free to start with a credits-based system.

**Who made Waysorted?**
Waysorted is developed by Waysorted Infotech Pvt Ltd.

**Does Waysorted upload my designs?**
No. Waysorted uses local-first architecture - your designs are processed on your device, never uploaded to servers.
